title: Saigon and the Delta Break
alt: Floating market boats loaded with fruit in the Mekong Delta
transport: Private transfers and guided day tours from the city

stops.name: Ho Chi Minh City
stops.hotel: Cap Town Hotel, Ho Chi Minh
stops.accom: 4 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Small hotel in District 1, close to the market lanes

activities.name: Saigon half day city tour
activities.match: Half Day Ho Chi Minh City Tour
activities.description: The Reunification Palace, the old post office and Notre Dame cathedral, then the war remnants museum and the Ben Thanh market.

activities.name: Mekong Delta full day tour
activities.description: South to My Tho for a boat into the coconut creeks, a sampan through the palms, and the workshops where they make coconut candy.

activities.name: Cu Chi tunnels in a small group
activities.match: Cu Chi Tunnels Half Day Tour - Small Group
activities.description: The tunnel network north west of the city in a small group, with the trapdoors, the kitchens and a crawl through the shafts.

program.name: Ho Chi Minh City
program.description: Four nights in District 1 with the city, a full day in the Mekong Delta, the Cu Chi tunnels and a day of your own.

1: Arrival at Tan Son Nhat and transfer to your hotel
A half day of the city with a guide
The palace, the cathedral and the war remnants museum
Check in and the evening free
2: Breakfast, then south into the delta
A boat through the coconut creeks at My Tho
A sampan ride under the palms
The coconut candy workshops, then back to the city
3: Breakfast, then north west to Cu Chi
The tunnels in a small group with a guide
The trapdoors, the kitchens and the shafts
4: Breakfast, then a free day in Saigon
Optional: a cooking class or the Cao Dai temple
Optional: Saigon square and the market stalls
5: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Tan Son Nhat for your flight home

expert.name: Riya
expert.quote: One hotel, four nights, three days out. The easiest way to see the south without moving your bags.
expert.tip: Take the small group Cu Chi tour rather than the coach. You get into the tunnels while they are still empty.

summary: A short southern break: four nights in District 1 in Saigon with a guided half day of the city on arrival, a full day in the Mekong Delta, the Cu Chi tunnels in a small group, and a free day before the flight home.
included: Included: 4 nights with breakfast and dinner daily; private transfers throughout; a half day Saigon city tour; a full day Mekong Delta tour; a small group Cu Chi tunnels tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Vietnam visa fees; lunches; travel insurance; personal expenses.
